# DADA2 分析流程

::: {.callout-tip}
使用 DADA2 对测序原始数据进行降噪处理，生成 ASV 表（Amplicon Sequence Variants）。
:::

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: dada2-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(dada2)
library(Biostrings)
```

## 配置数据路径

```{r}
#| label: setup-paths
# Silva 数据库文件路径（需提前下载）。可通过环境变量 SILVA_DB_FILE 覆盖。
SILVA_DB_FILE = Sys.getenv(
    "SILVA_DB_FILE",
    "/mnt/user/PUBLIC/silva_16s/silva_nr99_v138.2_toSpecies_trainset.fa.gz"
)

PROJECT_DIR = if (dir.exists("clean data")) "." else ".."

# 原始数据目录（clean data 中的已拼接 FASTQ 文件）
CLEAN_DATA_DIR = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "clean data")
RESULT_DIR = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "dada2-result")

# 过滤后的 FASTQ 输出到项目目录，避免每次渲染都丢失中间结果。
FILTERED_DATA_DIR = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "dada2-filtered")

DADA2_MULTITHREAD = as.logical(Sys.getenv("DADA2_MULTITHREAD", "FALSE"))
DADA2_NBASES = as.numeric(Sys.getenv("DADA2_NBASES", "1e8"))
RUN_DADA2 = as.logical(Sys.getenv("RUN_DADA2", "FALSE"))
RESULT_FILES = file.path(RESULT_DIR, c("asv-table.csv", "tax-table.csv", "asv.fasta"))
SKIP_DADA2 = !RUN_DADA2 && all(file.exists(RESULT_FILES))

if (SKIP_DADA2) {
    cat("检测到已有 DADA2 结果，跳过重分析。若需重新运行完整 DADA2 流程，请将本章 DADA2 主流程 chunk 的 eval 选项改回 true。\n")
}
```

## 获取拼接后的 FASTQ 文件

我们的 clean data 中已经是拼接好的 FASTQ 文件，可直接用于 DADA2 降噪。

```{r}
#| label: list-assembled-files
fnFs = list.files(CLEAN_DATA_DIR, pattern = "\\.assembled\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
sample_names = basename(fnFs) |> str_remove("\\.assembled\\.fastq\\.gz$")

if (length(fnFs) == 0) {
    stop("未在 ", CLEAN_DATA_DIR, " 中找到 .assembled.fastq.gz 文件。")
}

cat("共找到", length(fnFs), "个拼接后的 FASTQ 文件\n")
head(sample_names)
```

## 数据质量

```{r}
#| label: plot-quality-profiles
#| eval: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
library(cowplot)
# 随机选 6 个样本查看质量（太多会拥挤）
set.seed(42)
idx = sample(length(fnFs), min(6, length(fnFs)))
plots = lapply(fnFs[idx], function(f) {
    plotQualityProfile(f) + ggtitle(basename(f))
})
plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 2)
```

## 过滤

由于是已经拼接好的序列，我们只进行质量控制过滤（不截断，保留全长已拼接序列）。

```{r}
#| label: filter-and-trim
#| eval: false
dir.create(FILTERED_DATA_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
filtFs = file.path(FILTERED_DATA_DIR, paste0(sample_names, "_F_filt.fq.gz"))
filter_stats_file = file.path(FILTERED_DATA_DIR, "filter-stats.csv")

if (file.exists(filter_stats_file) && all(file.exists(filtFs))) {
    cat("使用已有过滤结果:", FILTERED_DATA_DIR, "\n")
    out = as.matrix(read.csv(filter_stats_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
} else {
    cat("开始过滤", length(fnFs), "个 FASTQ 文件，输出目录:", FILTERED_DATA_DIR, "\n")
    out = filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs,
                  maxN = 0, maxEE = 2, truncQ = 2,
                  rm.phix = FALSE,
                  compress = TRUE,
                  multithread = DADA2_MULTITHREAD)
    write.csv(out, filter_stats_file)
    cat("过滤完成。\n")
}
head(out)
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-summary
#| eval: false
cat("过滤后保留序列占比:",
    round(sum(out[,2]) / sum(out[,1]) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# 识别序列量偏低的样本
low_samples = out[out[,2] < 1000, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(low_samples) > 0) {
    cat("警告：以下样本过滤后序列数 < 1000，建议剔除：\n")
    print(low_samples)
}
```

## 学习错误率

```{r}
#| label: learn-error-rates
#| eval: false
cat("开始学习错误率。\n")
errF = learnErrors(filtFs, nbases = DADA2_NBASES, multithread = DADA2_MULTITHREAD)
cat("错误率学习完成。\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-error-rates
#| eval: false
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8
plotErrors(errF, nominalQ = TRUE)
```

## 去重与降噪

```{r}
#| label: dereplicate-and-dada
#| eval: false
cat("开始去重。\n")
derepFs = derepFastq(filtFs)
cat("开始降噪。\n")
dadaFs = dada(derepFs, err = errF, multithread = DADA2_MULTITHREAD, verbose = TRUE)
cat("降噪完成。\n")
```

## 生成 ASV 表

```{r}
#| label: make-sequence-table
#| eval: false
# 对于已拼接序列，dada() 的输出已是最终 ASV
seqtab = makeSequenceTable(dadaFs)
cat("ASV 表维度（样本数 × ASV 数）:", dim(seqtab), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-sequence-length
#| eval: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6
# 查看序列长度分布
len_dist = table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
plot(len_dist, type = 'l', xlab = "序列长度 (bp)", ylab = "ASV 数",
     main = "ASV 序列长度分布")
```

### 按长度过滤

V4 区的期望长度约为 250 bp，保留主峰附近的序列。

```{r}
#| label: filter-by-length
#| eval: false
max_len = which.max(len_dist) |> names() |> as.numeric()
seqtab2 = seqtab[, nchar(getSequences(seqtab)) %in% (max_len - 30):(max_len + 30)]
cat("按长度过滤后维度:", dim(seqtab2), "\n")
cat("保留的序列占比:", round(sum(seqtab2) / sum(seqtab) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

### 去嵌合体

```{r}
#| label: remove-chimeras
#| eval: false
seqtab.nochim = removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab2, multithread = DADA2_MULTITHREAD)
cat("去嵌合体后维度:", dim(seqtab.nochim), "\n")
cat("去嵌合体后保留的 ASV 数占比:", round(sum(seqtab.nochim) / sum(seqtab2) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("去嵌合体后序列数占比:", round(dim(seqtab.nochim)[2] / dim(seqtab2)[2] * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

## 各步骤追踪

```{r}
#| label: track-reads
#| eval: false
getN = function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track = cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), rowSums(seqtab2), rowSums(seqtab.nochim))
colnames(track) = c("input", "filtered", "denoised", "filter_by_len", "nonchim")
rownames(track) = sample_names

# 只显示前 20 行
head(track, 20)
```

```{r}
#| label: track-summary
#| eval: false
summary(track)
```

## 注释分类

```{r}
#| label: assign-taxonomy
#| eval: false
# 分配到属级别
if (file.exists(SILVA_DB_FILE)) {
    taxa = assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, SILVA_DB_FILE, multithread = DADA2_MULTITHREAD, minBoot = 60)
} else {
    warning(
        "未找到 SILVA 分类数据库：", SILVA_DB_FILE,
        "。将 ASV 分类标记为 Unclassified；设置 SILVA_DB_FILE 环境变量后可重新生成分类注释。"
    )
    taxa = matrix(
        "Unclassified",
        nrow = ncol(seqtab.nochim),
        ncol = 6,
        dimnames = list(
            colnames(seqtab.nochim),
            c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: assign-species
#| eval: false
# 尝试分配到种级别
SILVA_SPECIES_FILE = str_replace(SILVA_DB_FILE, "trainset", "species_assignment")
if (file.exists(SILVA_SPECIES_FILE)) {
    taxa_species = assignSpecies(seqtab.nochim, SILVA_SPECIES_FILE)
} else {
    taxa_species = matrix(
        NA_character_,
        nrow = ncol(seqtab.nochim),
        ncol = 1,
        dimnames = list(colnames(seqtab.nochim), "Species")
    )
}
```

## 添加种水平注释

```{r}
#| label: merge-taxonomy
#| eval: false
# 将属级别和种级别注释合并
taxa_with_species = cbind(taxa, Species = taxa_species[, "Species"])
```

## 保存结果

```{r}
#| label: save-results
path_result = RESULT_DIR
dir.create(path_result, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

### 生成 ASV ID

```{r}
#| label: generate-asv-ids
#| eval: false
asv_sequence = getSequences(seqtab.nochim)
library(digest)
get_dna_id = function(seq, length = 8){
    hash = digest::digest(seq, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
    substr(hash, 1, length)
}

asv_id = paste0("ASV", sapply(asv_sequence, get_dna_id))
```

### 保存 FASTA

```{r}
#| label: save-fasta
#| eval: false
asv_fasta = paste0(">", asv_id, "\n", asv_sequence)
writeLines(asv_fasta, file.path(path_result, "asv.fasta"))
```

### 保存 ASV 表和分类表

```{r}
#| label: save-tables
#| eval: false
colnames(seqtab.nochim) = asv_id
write.csv(seqtab.nochim, file.path(path_result, "asv-table.csv"))

rownames(taxa_with_species) = asv_id
write.csv(taxa_with_species, file.path(path_result, "tax-table.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-files
cat("DADA2 分析结果已保存至:", RESULT_DIR, "\n")
cat("- ASV 表:", file.path(RESULT_DIR, "asv-table.csv"), "\n")
cat("- 分类表:", file.path(RESULT_DIR, "tax-table.csv"), "\n")
cat("- ASV 序列:", file.path(RESULT_DIR, "asv.fasta"), "\n")
if (!all(file.exists(RESULT_FILES))) {
    stop("DADA2 结果文件不完整；请设置 RUN_DADA2=true 重新运行预处理流程。")
}
```
